source_class: official regulator event report / enforcement / inspection finding
may_do: reopen a claim; impose cap; create mandatory local packet; contradict self-attested closure
may_not_do: close local readiness by itself unless paired with local corrective-action and retest evidence
examples: NRC EN58200; ROP findings; action-matrix changes

source_class: current state/county REP plan or RERP
may_do: establish current planning context, roles, named support documents, and local artifact demand
may_not_do: prove exercised performance, facility operability, route capacity, or CAP closure
examples: Ohio 2025 REP Plan; Columbiana 2026 RERP; WV REP 2023 when acquired
tie_breaker_rule: current official plan beats brochure, but cannot beat event counterevidence

source_class: raw machine feed / official data catalog
may_do: refresh clock, feed public PI/action-matrix/event schedule overlays, expose changes
may_not_do: skip parser/hash/reconciliation or substitute for local evidence

source_class: public fact sheet, public mailer, brochure, press release, schedule
may_do: inform public context and evidence-demand mapping
may_not_do: close route, alerting, AFN, CRC, mass-care, KI, or exercise performance rows
examples: PEMA fact sheet; Beaver County mailer; FEMA future exercise notice
tie_breaker_rule: use as public-context only; no local closure

may_do: add search lead or public-behavior context when official source unavailable
may_not_do: provide official status, closure, or readiness score
examples: local article about KI distribution or exercise logistics
tie_breaker_rule: must be replaced by official source before claim

may_do: test pipeline logic and failure modes
may_not_do: apply to real site or jurisdiction without explicit real evidence packet
